findings.root_cause: Edge direction confusion in rate-limit gate
findings.impact: Intermittent route acceptance/rejection
findings.fix: Unify rate-limit semantics
findings.regression_test: Unit test: fine_rate true counts as fine

findings.root_cause: ws_client panics on connection error
findings.impact: Process crash on WS drop
findings.fix: Return Result instead of panicking
findings.regression_test: Unit test: ws_client returns Err on invalid addr

findings.root_cause: Runway counting off-by-one
findings.impact: Opportunities lost in window
findings.fix: Fix runway computation
findings.regression_test: Dispatch integration test: zero-runway returns None

findings.root_cause: V1 build_bytes returns 87 bytes; callers assume 1232
findings.impact: Size assertions wrong for V1-native transactions
findings.fix: Update size assertions: V1 ceiling is 4096
findings.regression_test: V1 size-ladder tests: wire size <= 4096

findings.root_cause: consume_bin_liquidity returns 0 remaining on partial bin
findings.impact: Partial-bin quoting incorrect
findings.fix: Fix remaining computation for partial bins
findings.regression_test: Bin liquidity tests: partial consumption

findings.root_cause: build_kamino_flash_repay missing PDA verification
findings.impact: Security gap: tampered PDA could redirect fees
findings.fix: Add PDA verification of fee_vault and authority
findings.regression_test: Kamino repay test: PDA verification fails when invalid

findings.root_cause: Admin endpoints blocked by CORS for browser access
findings.impact: Web dashboard admin features inaccessible
findings.fix: Add CORS preflight handling for Authorization header
findings.regression_test: Web API login test: returned token works in /pause, /resume

findings.root_cause: LatestReceivedTickSlip never implemented
findings.impact: Tick stream slots not accurately tracked
findings.fix: Document as intentionally unused; use RPC pool slot
findings.regression_test: Documentation review: no code path depends on undefined field

findings.root_cause: timed_out_transaction margin ambiguous
findings.impact: Late-confirmed transactions marked timed out; duplicate dispatch
findings.fix: Separate blockhash validity from signature status; margin 160 documented
findings.regression_test: Recovery test: known status; timed_out only when blockhash stale

findings.root_cause: Account ordering mismatch with Meteora SDK
findings.impact: Instruction may be rejected by validators
findings.fix: Align account order with official SDK: token_x, token_y, reserve_x, reserve_y, oracle, label, bin_arrays
findings.regression_test: Meteora 2-pool tests: account order matches SDK

findings.root_cause: build_and_sign_transaction does not include priority fee
findings.impact: V1 transactions may fail at execution
findings.fix: Add priority fee to message config
findings.regression_test: Template test: V1 message includes priority fee

findings.root_cause: build_kamino_flash_borrow hardcodes ORCA_WSOL_POOL
findings.impact: Wrong vault PDA for non-default markets
findings.fix: Derive supply vault from reserve account state
findings.regression_test: Kamino borrow test: supply vault derived from reserve state

findings.root_cause: ProductQuantity uses f64 for factor
findings.impact: Precision loss for very large tokens
findings.fix: Use u128/i128 for factors; convert to f64 only for display
findings.regression_test: Dimensional tests: large values match integer math

findings.root_cause: Optimizer uses same bid pool for both directions
findings.impact: Wrong direction selection; overly conservative fine search
findings.fix: Ensure DirectionA and DirectionB are truly different; use granular quotes
findings.regression_test: Optimizer test: both directions evaluated; fine search uses granular quotes

findings.root_cause: Dispatch intent written before broadcast confirmation
findings.impact: Duplicate dispatch on recovery if original broadcast succeeded
findings.fix: Write intent after transaction confirmed; use signature status as source of truth
findings.regression_test: Recovery test: no duplicate dispatch after crash

findings.root_cause: Flash fee rounding may use truncation instead of ties-away
findings.impact: Small profit differences near bin boundaries
findings.fix: Verify rounding against official klend formula; update test
findings.regression_test: Flash fee test: fee matches official klend formula

findings.root_cause: Unsupported DAMM v2 function types return None instead of typed error
findings.impact: Silent failure for unsupported function types
findings.fix: Return typed error DammV2Error::UnsupportedFunctionType
findings.regression_test: DAMM v2 test: unsupported function type returns typed error

findings.root_cause: Three-pool test uses mocked tokens, no real pool state
findings.impact: Test only proves account assembly, not on-chain correctness
findings.fix: Add integration tests with fork/litesvm simulation
findings.regression_test: Three-pool integration test: simulates against real pool state

findings.root_cause: Opportunity counting affects runway computation incorrectly
findings.impact: Off-by-one in runway accounting; mis-evaluated opportunities
findings.fix: Count only opportunities passing all gates; separate rejected vs ignored
findings.regression_test: Supervisor test: runway consistent with filtering semantics

findings.root_cause: Health check threshold hardcoded at 10 seconds; response content not verified
findings.impact: Temporary slow provider marked unhealthy; unnecessary fallback
findings.fix: Make threshold configurable; verify slot number is increasing
findings.regression_test: Provider supervisor test: correct status for configurable thresholds

findings.root_cause: Bin array PDA derivation uses fixed seed, not pool mint authority
findings.impact: PDA mismatch for pools with custom bin steps or seeds
findings.fix: Use pool mint authority as seed for bin array derivation
findings.regression_test: Bin array test: PDA matches on-chain for custom bin steps

findings.root_cause: Falls back to V1 without checking V1 wire size against 4096 limit
findings.impact: Generic error instead of specific too-large error
findings.fix: Check V1 wire size before failing; return TxError::TransactionTooLargeForV1
findings.regression_test: Adaptive compiler test: transaction > 4096 returns correct error

findings.root_cause: Config validation missing; defaults silently used for missing required keys
findings.impact: Dangerous defaults (e.g. max_trade_size_usd)
findings.fix: Add validation phase: fail-closed on missing required keys
findings.regression_test: Config validation test: missing key causes startup failure

findings.root_cause: Flash fee rounding uses truncation, not ties-away
findings.impact: 1 lamport difference; marginal routes may flip
findings.fix: Verify ties-away rounding against klend; add boundary tests
findings.regression_test: Flash fee test: ties-away matches klend reference

findings.root_cause: Hardcoded reserve PDA derivation; no on-chain verification
findings.impact: Wrong PDA for different lending markets
findings.fix: Verify derived PDA; compute correct PDA from actual market state
findings.regression_test: Kamino borrow test: PDA matches on-chain for different markets

findings.root_cause: No check for tip account balance before dispatch
findings.impact: Transaction fails at dispatch if tip account underfunded
findings.fix: Verify tip account balance before dispatch; add health check
findings.regression_test: Jito service test: insufficient balance returns error

findings.root_cause: No sender role verification for state-changing Telegram commands
findings.impact: Unauthorized group users can control bot
findings.fix: Whitelist specific user IDs; require bot admin role
findings.regression_test: Telegram test: non-whitelisted user cannot send /pause

findings.root_cause: Fine search uses worst_case_accumulated_profit, overly conservative
findings.impact: Suboptimal size selection; lower profit
findings.fix: Use per-leg quoted profit; adaptive step size; local search
findings.regression_test: 3-leg optimizer test: converges to expected size

findings.root_cause: V1 message config missing loaded data size limit
findings.impact: V1 transactions loading >0 bytes fail on loader
findings.fix: Add loaded data size limit to message config
findings.regression_test: V1 message test: loaded data size limit set correctly

findings.root_cause: No mainnet URL validation for WebSocket endpoints
findings.impact: Wrong network data if devnet/testnet URL used
findings.fix: Validate RPC URL is mainnet at startup
findings.regression_test: WS test: startup fails if URL not mainnet

findings.root_cause: Hardcoded target account count at 12
findings.impact: Repayment fails on markets with different account layouts
findings.fix: Derive account list dynamically; verify count matches
findings.regression_test: Kamino repay test: account count matches actual layout

findings.root_cause: Hash set dedup key too coarse (no bin-level fingerprint)
findings.impact: Under-reported routes; missed better opportunities
findings.fix: Include bin-level fingerprint in dedup key
findings.regression_test: Opportunity test: routes with different bin selections are distinct

findings.root_cause: Hardcoded authority account in builder
findings.impact: Swaps fail on delegated-authority pools
findings.fix: Resolve authority from on-chain state
findings.regression_test: Raydium V4 test: builder works with delegated authority pools

findings.root_cause: V1 signature extraction returns legacy wire signature data
findings.impact: Wrong signature for template-built transactions
findings.fix: Separate V1 and legacy signature extraction
findings.regression_test: Adaptive compiler test: V1 signature extraction correct

findings.root_cause: No blockhash validity check before re-dispatch
findings.impact: Race condition: stale blockhash may cause double spend or missed re-dispatch
findings.fix: Check blockhash validity (< 150 slots) first; remove stale intents
findings.regression_test: Recovery test: stale blockhash removed; valid triggers re-broadcast if needed

findings.root_cause: 200_000 CU limit used for V1 threshold (confused with account count threshold)
findings.impact: No critical issue; threshold separation is correct
findings.fix: Document separate thresholds for CU limit vs wire size

findings.root_cause: No minimum password entropy check
findings.impact: Weak passwords brute-forceable
findings.fix: Enforce min 16 chars with mixed complexity
findings.regression_test: Config test: weak password fails; strong password passes

findings.root_cause: Hardcoded r2d2 pool size; no backpressure handling
findings.impact: Dropped dispatch intents under high load
findings.fix: Make pool size configurable; add backpressure handling
findings.regression_test: Store test: pool rejects connections gracefully under high load

findings.root_cause: Session tokens compared with non-constant-time equality
findings.impact: Timing attack vulnerability; expired sessions linger
findings.fix: Use constant-time comparison; enforce expiry in lookup
findings.regression_test: Web API test: constant-time session comparison; expired rejected

findings.root_cause: f64 multiplication for lamports/USDC conversion
findings.impact: Rounding errors for large trade amounts
findings.fix: Use integer arithmetic with u128 intermediate
findings.regression_test: Currency test: large values match integer math

findings.root_cause: Health monitor reports ready before provider connectivity confirmed
findings.impact: Dashboard shows ready; bot cannot execute
findings.fix: Wait for at least one provider before marking ready
findings.regression_test: Health monitor test: not ready until provider connected

findings.root_cause: No checked arithmetic for dex_fees, network_costs, expected_output
findings.impact: Silent saturation; incorrect net profit
findings.fix: Use checked arithmetic; u128 intermediate; explicit overflow error
findings.regression_test: Economic quote test: large values do not overflow; error on overflow

summary.recommendation: P0 findings resolved: no panic-based WS connection, rate-limit gate unified, runway computation verified. Remaining: P1 financial/protocol fixes, V1/ALT revalidation, B-3 test fix, B-4 metrics migration, B-5 fork evidence.
